* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Effect: Polarized Negative Power Coupling, Dagobah, R
|strategy=By Boba Fett

This Light Side effect is one of my favorite cards from [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], hands down. It has a myriad of uses, some of which are quite obvious, while others are oh so subtle. Once [[Polarized Negative Power Coupling]] hits the table, both players' Used Piles are placed face up, and any cards moved into the Used Pile are face up. This not only lets you see the cards of your deck, it allows you to spy on your opponent's deck, and see what type of strategies he is running. This can be an overwhelming advantage, because if you dont see any starships in his deck, you know you can control the stars with little trouble. If he's running all space, you can spread thin at sites and drain a ton.

One combo that is made easy to pull off is [[Polarized Negative Power Coupling]] and [[Visored Vision]]. We all know that some folks love to play five [[Dark Maneuvers]] in a row in order to stack big destiny draws together, but [[Visored Vision]] makes them lose Force for each named interrupt sitting in their Used Pile. See your opponent's The Circle is Now Complete go into the Used Pile? Use [[Visored Vision]] lost and send it to his Lost Pile.

Another combo I like is to set [[Yoda]] out at his hut, and play [[Jedi Levitation]] to pull any one card out of your Used Pile into your hand, for only the cost of losing the [[Levitation]]. (The cost is 7-X, where X represents the ability of your highest ability character on table.) So, you have [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] in hand but can't seem to get ahold of his stick? Oh, it just went into Used Pile, well, I'll Jedi Levitate it right into my hand. And with Figrin out and a Reflecting [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]], you are constantly retrieving two Force a turn, plus, getting a chance to see eight of your cards go into the Used Pile. (Four from the gamble, four from the [[Reflection]].) [[Polarized Negative Power Coupling]] is a great card, and does not take a whole lot of resources in order to cause your opponent tons of frustration, and some Force loss as well.
